reviews.text:
Great experience from start to finish.  Travis was kind enough to stop by and consult with us during the construction holiday and completed the work in a very timely manner.
Two things I want to point out:
Our job was relatively small - yet he took the time to address the issues. That was very appreciated.
2nd was that he and his team were tasked with redoing someone else’s recent bad work.  I see this all the time in my business and it can be challenging to come in and have to redo something that wasn’t done right the first time.
Overall we are very pleased and would highly recommend TD Renovations wholeheartedly.

It's been a few months since I've gotten my basement floors done and honestly TD Reno did an amazing job! Paul was super friendly and easy to get a hold of and Kyle was an absolute gem! Such a fast and diligent worker. If I had more projects to do around the house I'd call these guys back in a heartbeat! A big thank you to Rich and Eric as well, honestly such a pleasure working with you all!
10/10 would recommend!

After our basement suffered extensive water damage from a flood, we were overwhelmed and unsure where to begin. Enter TD Renovations—an absolute game-changer. From the moment we contacted them, their team provided reassurance, expertise, and a clear plan to restore and transform our basement.

They approached the renovation with professionalism and care, keeping us informed at every step and making sure the project stayed on schedule. What impressed us most was their ability to turn a stressful situation into a seamless experience. The crew was punctual, respectful, and maintained a clean worksite throughout the project.

TD Renovations didn’t just restore our basement—they improved it beyond what we had before. The new space is beautifully finished, and more functional than ever. Their attention to detail, quality materials, and thoughtful design truly exceeded our expectations.

We’re incredibly grateful to TD Renovations for giving us back a safe, beautiful space—and peace of mind. If you’re dealing with a flood-damaged basement or any other renovations you might need, don’t hesitate to call them. They’re honest, skilled, and dedicated to getting the job done right.

A special thank you to the owner, Travis, who is not only a true professional but also one of the kindest and most understanding people we’ve worked with. His leadership sets the tone for the entire team. Thank you to Paul, whose guidance kept us confident throughout; to Stephanie, for her brilliant design vision; and to Chris, who led the project with precision and care. We’re also deeply grateful to Richard, Nathan, Julian, Greg, Brad, Kyle, James, Jennifer and everyone involved for their hard work, craftsmanship, and dedication. You all made a lasting difference in our home and our lives.

Pat Kade

Thanks to TD Reno for a great job on my basement Reno. Thanks to Paul for always responding quickly to all my inquiries and for ensuring the estimated quote matched the final invoice. Thank to all the guys (Kyle, Brad and James) who worked so hard and were always right on time and considerate with keeping the place clean. Thanks to Chris for ensuring everything ran smooth and the end results projected the professionals you are. Great job!

We hired TD Renovations for a complete renovation of our master bathroom down to the studs. Throughout the process, we were impressed with their professionalism and expertise. They worked diligently and efficiently, exceeding our expectations at every turn. The communication was excellent, they respected delays and budget, and were very responsive. The trades who worked on the project were very skilled, experienced and respectful while in our home. Their customer care is outstanding and they always made sure that the project was meeting our expectations. I highly recommend TD Renovations and look forward to hiring them again for our next renovation projects.
